name: meisijiya-minimalist-ui
description: Premium utilitarian minimalist & editorial UI protocol for Linear/Notion-style product surfaces. Enforces high-contrast warm monochrome palette + spot pastels, bespoke typographic hierarchy (sans body + serif display), asymmetric CSS Grid bento layouts, ultra-flat bordered components with crisp 8–12px radius, understated spring motion.

positive_triggers.input: Build a Linear-style task management interface with editorial typography
positive_triggers.reason: Linear aesthetic named; this is the active direction skill

positive_triggers.input: Make our product UI feel Notion-clean — monochrome + bento + restrained motion
positive_triggers.reason: Notion aesthetic named; minimalist-ui is the direction

positive_triggers.input: Design a premium utilitarian editorial console for our customers

negative_triggers.input: Premium consumer cookware marketing landing — palette should feel warm and craft
negative_triggers.reason: Marketing landing without a named Linear/Notion aesthetic; route to meisijiya-frontend-taste

negative_triggers.input: Awwwards-style experimental site with bold motion and asymmetric overflow
negative_triggers.reason: Awwwards is the opposite direction (chaos vs utilitarian calm)

negative_triggers.input: Brutalist industrial terminal site with halftone + monospace + CRT scanlines
negative_triggers.reason: Brutalist uses a separate aesthetic family

behavioral_evals.scenario: User asks: 'Build a Linear-style task management interface with editorial typography'
expected_behavior: Agent has loaded meisijiya-frontend-taste first; this skill is loaded AFTER
Agent narrows dials to variance 5–6, motion 3–4, density 3
Agent applies macro-whitespace (py-24+, max-w-4xl to max-w-5xl)
Agent uses three-tier typography (sans body + serif display + mono) consistently
Agent restricts colors to warm monochrome + spot pastels or named brand; no neon, no gradients on body
Agent keeps card radius 8–12px; primary CTA radius 4–6px; no rounded-full on either
Agent uses ONE icon family (Phosphor Bold or Radix) at one stroke weight
Agent uses IntersectionObserver / motion/react whileInView for entry; never useState driving scroll
Agent runs verification (§Verification) before declaring done

notes: v0.1.0 — based on Leonxlnx/taste-skill minimalist-skill (MIT). Behavioral evals are warning-level until promoted via upstream issue tracker.
